meta.name: DAGM. Y
meta.tagline: I enjoy working with businesses and creative individuals.
meta.aboutBio:
I'm Dagmawi, a freelance WordPress and Elementor developer based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. I build websites that load fast, look sharp, and actually convert visitors into customers.

Over the past three years I've delivered dozens of sites for clients across the US, UK, and Africa — from WooCommerce stores handling real transactions to landing pages that boosted conversion rates by 40%. I care about the details that most people skip: sub-3-second load times, mobile layouts that don't break, and SEO structure that helps people find you.

When I'm not building sites, I'm probably tinkering with something on my own. I believe every business deserves a website that works as hard as they do — and I like being the person who makes that happen.
meta.specialization: Specializing in fast, mobile-responsive, SEO-friendly websites that drive results.

projects.title: MeskelPay
projects.caseStudy: Ethiopian fintech platform bridging WooCommerce with local payment infrastructure. Built with Next.js 16 and Neon Postgres for real-time transaction processing, with a custom WooCommerce plugin for inventory sync.

projects.title: JB Dondolo
projects.caseStudy: Nonprofit e-commerce site selling handcrafted goods to fund community projects. WooCommerce with LiteSpeed Cache keeps the store fast on shared hosting, even with international traffic.

projects.title: Syndicore Media
projects.caseStudy: Creative agency site with a custom WordPress theme and bespoke Elementor widgets. Built custom post types for portfolio management and Nginx caching for sub-2-second loads.

projects.title: Heron Dance
projects.caseStudy: Dance company site on Squarespace with custom CSS for a clean, editorial look. Focused on responsive layouts and fast image loading for their photo-heavy content.

projects.title: Lonestar Peptides
projects.caseStudy: Supplement store with wholesale pricing tiers, age-gated checkout, and custom payment gateways. WooCommerce with a child theme for client-editable product pages and CF7 for customer inquiries.

projects.title: True Light Pools
projects.caseStudy: Pool service company site on Squarespace with custom CSS. Clean service pages and a booking-focused layout designed to convert local search traffic into calls.

projects.title: BPS Pools
projects.caseStudy: Pool supply store with Elementor Pro and Astra theme. Added Ultimate Addons for custom widgets, Breeze Cache for performance, and Smush Pro for image optimization across hundreds of product photos.

projects.title: The Arch International
projects.caseStudy: International consulting firm site built on Hello Elementor with Tablesome for data management. Clean, professional design with structured content for a global audience.

projects.title: Rose Bookshop
projects.caseStudy: Online bookstore with WooCommerce, Slider Revolution for featured titles, and Mailchimp integration for newsletter signups. ChapterOne theme customized for a literary, editorial feel.

testimonials.name: Lumbie Mlambo
testimonials.quote: Dagmawi is incredible in his work and personality! He's very thorough and I've had nothing but everything positive to say about him. If you're looking for professionalism and reliability, Dagmawi is your person. I highly recommend him with no reservations.

testimonials.name: Jamila Bell
testimonials.quote: Very satisfied with the work completed by Dagmawi. We needed a new website for our business and he put together a top-tier, beautiful high-end website within 48 hours for us to review and approve. Not only was he attentive to our needs, but he also asked us if there's any revisions that needed to be made and kept consistent communication with us throughout the whole process. Highly recommended!

testimonials.quote: Thank you Dagmawi for not only building the site like we had thought of with zero references.
